title: CISA Cross-Sector Cybersecurity Performance Goals, Version 1.0.1
summary: CISA's cross-sector performance goals present a voluntary, prioritized baseline of cybersecurity practices intended to reduce common critical-infrastructure risks and map implementation work to NIST Cybersecurity Framework functions.
key_findings: CISA selected goals intended to materially reduce common cross-sector risk while remaining actionable and feasible for smaller organizations.
The revised presentation aligns goals with NIST CSF functions and provides checklist and matrix resources.
CISA explicitly distinguishes individual goal implementation from complete fulfillment of a referenced NIST CSF subcategory.
why_it_matters: The goals provide a practical baseline that can organize operator evidence requests without confusing voluntary guidance with verified control implementation.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a cross-sector cybersecurity baseline for local infrastructure dossiers.
Supports evidence requests for named assets, owners, controls, dates, and implementation status.
Creates a bridge between CISA operational guidance and NIST framework outcomes.
evidence_limits: The goals are voluntary and do not independently establish compliance.
The document does not prove that an organization implemented a control or reduced risk.
Sector-specific requirements and binding directives must be evaluated separately.
